title: Biden-appointed judge deals Trump another sanctuary city defeat in major immigration fight
summary: A federal judge ruled Trump's lawsuit against New York City's sanctuary policies fails, citing the 10th Amendment's anti-commandeering doctrine.

title: Army expo attendees skeptical of Trump's Iran peace deal hopes: 'Beat 'em into submission'
summary: AUSA Exposition attendees question Trump's optimism about an Iran deal, arguing military and economic sanctions must intensify before Tehran talks.

title: Tish James confronted on camera over Trump's accusation of bias in Cornell rape case
summary: Letitia James vows a fair probe into the alleged Cornell University gang rape, but Trump and defense attorneys question her impartiality.

title: Liberal-city resident hesitates when pressed on beliefs: 'I hadn't really thought about socialism that way'
summary: Fox News Digital hit the streets of Portland, Maine, where residents offered sharply divided views on socialism, wealth inequality and capitalism.

title: Fatalities, injuries reported at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta after 'incident' that sparked fire
summary: Defense Minister David McGuinty confirmed fatalities and injuries after a major fire broke out at CFB Wainwright in Alberta, one of the country's busiest military bases.

title: College football faces another clock controversy after BYU upsets Notre Dame
summary: BYU's Bear Bachmeier scored three touchdowns as the unbeaten Cougars stunned Notre Dame 28-24, snapping the Fighting Irish's 16-game winning streak.

title: Rays even ALCS at two games apiece with Game 4 win over Guardians after series postponement
summary: The Tampa Bay Rays evened the ALCS at two games apiece as Yandy Diaz's two-out, two-run homer in the ninth sealed a dominant 7-3 Game 4 win.

title: Florida State falls again as Miami survives double-overtime scare to stay unbeaten
summary: Florida State's Duce Robinson forced overtime with a 75-yard touchdown, but No. 3 Miami's Darian Mensah delivered the winning score in double OT.

title: Joel Embiid rejects idea 76ers stars must 'take a back seat' as NBA regular season looms
summary: Joel Embiid scored 27 points in the 76ers' preseason finale and rejected the idea that Philadelphia's star-laden roster needs to sacrifice.

title: Michigan Democrat confirms sister-in-law's terror watchlist lawsuit days before Obama campaign appearance
summary: Abdul El-Sayed acknowledged his sister-in-law's involvement in a federal terrorist watchlist lawsuit, days before former President Barack Obama campaigns with him.
